items.title: An extension of the dualizing sheaf by a zero-dimensional quotient with at least two sections is globally generated
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file curves.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves global generation of any rank-1 extension of omega_X whose zero-dimensional quotient has at least two global sections (statement lines 1407-1414). The proof (lines 1416-1437) is a complete contradiction argument: the globally generated subsheaf with its rank-1 inclusion, the nonzero H^1 producing a map into omega_X, the closedness of the globally generated subsheaf under the induced self map, and the automorphism step (a standard fact the author marks details omitted) leading to the final contradiction. The single omitted detail is auxiliary and standard. H2: a clean contradiction chain with correctly ordered hinges.
